item.title: CVE-2026-133236 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Modoboa before 2.13.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability that allows Resellers or users with domain add or change permission to inject rspamd DKIM selector map entries by supplying an unvalidated dkim_key_selector through the relay domain API. Attackers can embed a carriage return in the selector to override another tenant's domain selector, causing rspamd to sign its outgoing mail with a nonexistent selector and fail DKIM verification.

item.title: CVE-2026-133237 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Manyfold 0.124.0 before 0.154.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to make the instance fetch internal URLs by supplying malicious ActivityPub actor icon.url and image.url fields. Attackers can deliver Create or Update activities to the inbox, causing the Shrine remote_url plugin to request internal or cloud metadata hosts and store responses as creator avatar or banner attachments.

item.title: CVE-2026-133238 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | SABnzbd through 5.1.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Sorter that allows attackers to write files outside the Complete folder via crafted propername, episodename or job name (%dn) values. Attackers can supply a malicious NZB with '...' sequences that collapse to '..' after single-pass replacement, moving downloaded files into arbitrary directories writable by SABnzbd.

item.title: CVE-2026-133239 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | OpnForm before 2.8.2 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to move other forms' shared assets by supplying their URLs in file upload fields. Attackers can submit a public form with another form's cover or logo URL, causing Storage::move() to relocate it into submissions and break that asset.

item.title: CVE-2026-133240 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | OpnForm before 2.8.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in PublicWebhookUrl::isPublicIp that fails to reject CGNAT, NAT64 and 6to4 address ranges. Authenticated users can configure webhook, form import or PDF image URLs resolving to these ranges to make the server send HTTPS requests to internal hosts.

item.title: CVE-2026-133241 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject iframe attributes via the maxheight parameter of the GET /oembed endpoint. Attackers can supply a single quote in maxheight to inject an onload handler into the returned html, executing script in third-party oEmbed consumers that embed it unsanitized.

item.title: CVE-2026-133242 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject script by crafting og:video:secure_url values. Attackers can post links to pages whose allowlisted-prefix video URL contains a quote and onload handler, executing script in readers' sessions when they click the video preview.

item.title: CVE-2026-133243 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8 | node-soap before 1.14.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in WSDL.xmlToObject that allows unauthenticated attackers to pollute Object.prototype via an XML element with id="__proto__". Attackers can send a single crafted SOAP request to a soap.listen() server, or return a malicious response to a client, causing all subsequent SOAP parsing to fail until process restart.

item.title: CVE-2026-133244 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | parse5-html-rewriting-stream 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in RewritingStream#emitText, which skips escaping based on a stale lastStartTagName. Attackers can place entity-encoded markup after a closed script or style element to bypass RewritingStream-based filters and execute script in users' browsers.

item.title: CVE-2026-133245 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | parse5 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains an uncaught exception vulnerability in Preprocessor#_processSurrogate that allows remote attackers to crash applications by supplying two consecutive low surrogates. Attackers can submit input such as U+DC00 U+DC00, which decodes to out-of-range code point 0x110000 and throws a RangeError from parse, parseFragment, or streaming parsers, crashing Node.js processes.

item.title: CVE-2026-62255 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, cram_index_load does not verify that the number of reference sequences in a CRAM .crai index does not exceed the CRAM header reference count. A malformed index can drive unbounded index-array allocation, and when the number of references in the index is within two of INT_MAX, the growth calculation can wrap, read beyond a heap buffer, and use the resulting value as a pointer for an unchecked memory write. Any region query can trigger the flaw, causing denial of service or memory corruption. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

item.title: CVE-2026-62256 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, fai_retrieve does not verify that the line width recorded in a FASTA .fai index is greater than or equal to the number of bases per line. When the line width is exactly one less than the base count, retrieval allocates an undersized heap buffer and writes one byte beyond its end; larger discrepancies instead cause an allocation failure that is handled. This issue can corrupt heap memory and crash the process. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

item.title: CVE-2026-62257 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8 | HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the experimental CRAM v4 XPACK and XRLE decoders cache expanded block pointers at indexes beyond the 512-element slice->block_by_id array. An array index partially controlled by data in the input file first causes an out-of-bounds read to determine whether a block is cached; a null value then causes allocation of a block and an out-of-bounds pointer write to the same element. The invalid read may crash the process, while the write may corrupt heap state and could permit arbitrary code execution. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

item.title: CVE-2026-62258 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8 | HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the CRAM decoder validates the 254-character query-name limit only after decoding the name into a 1024-byte stack array. An attacker-controlled CRAM record can provide an overlong query name and overflow the local stack buffer before the later validation runs; all CRAM format versions are affected. Opening such a file can crash the process, corrupt stack data, and may permit arbitrary code execution. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

item.title: CVE-2026-62259 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the experimental CRAM v4 functions cram_xpack_decode_char and cram_xrle_decode_char do not validate that attacker-controlled decode sizes remain within their expanded input arrays. Crafted CRAM data can therefore make either decoder read beyond the supplied input buffer, potentially disclosing process-state information or crashing the process through invalid memory access. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

item.title: CVE-2026-62260 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the CRAM BETA decoder functions cram_beta_decode_long, cram_beta_decode_int, and cram_beta_decode_char, and the experimental CRAM v4 XPACK functions cram_xpack_decode_long and cram_xpack_decode_int, have bounds-checking flaws caused by integer overflow after a multiplication. The resulting incorrect bounds check can allow decoding to read beyond the supplied input buffer, potentially leaking process-state information or crashing the process. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

item.title: CVE-2026-63390 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8 | HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the BCF reader can experience an integer overflow in a record-length check that verifies whether a record contains enough bytes for the expected number and size of stored items. A crafted BCF record can bypass this check, causing reads beyond the stored data and, in some cases, writes beyond the heap buffer when the reader sets the least significant bit of accessed bytes. Opening such a file can crash the process, corrupt data or heap structures, and may permit arbitrary code execution. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.
